text:
Call for One Week PlayStation Boycott Gains Traction Online - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
The pushback from fans over Sony's decision to kill physical media in a couple of years could lead to a one-week boycott. The social media account, Does It Play?, is proposing a one-week 'economic and gameplay blackout' starting Sunday, August 23rd at 7pm local time. No signing onto PSN, no turning on your PS5, no playing Sony games on Steam, etc. The post is gaining traction on X, with more than 1 million views so far. In other news, the Nintendo Switch 2 edition of Final Fantasy XIV will take up a whopping 117GB of internal space. This will increase next year, when the latest expansion drops. And finally, the first major expansion for STALKER 2, titled Cost of Hope, will drop on August 20th, along with a free 2.0 upgrade.

text:
Neagley: Season 1 - Official Teaser Trailer (Maria Sten, Greyston Holt) | Comic Con 2026
Check out the teaser trailer for Neagley, an upcoming series starring Maria Sten as Frances Neagley, Greyston Holt as Detective Hudson Riley, Adeline Rudolph as Renee Birdwhistle, Jasper Jones as Keno, Matthew Del Negro as Pierce Woodrow, and Damon Herriman as Lawrence Cole. Alan Ritchson guest stars as Jack Reacher. All 8 episodes of Neagley: Season 1 will be released on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 on Prime Video.

Frances Neagley (Maria Sten) is a private investigator in Chicago and former military protégé of Jack Reacher (Alan Ritchson) in the Army’s 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice. Using everything she’s learned from Jack Reacher and her time as a member of the 110 Special Investigators, Neagley puts herself on a dangerous path to uncover a menacing evil.

Based on the character in novels by Lee Child, Neagley is produced by Paramount Television Studios and Amazon MGM Studios. The series is created by executive producers and co-showrunners Nick Santora (Reacher, Prison Break, FUBAR) and Nicholas Wootton (Scorpion, The Endgame). In addition to Santora and Wootton, the series is executive produced by Lee Child, Don Granger, Sam Hill, Adam Higgs, and Lisa Kussner. Sam Hill served as director on the first two episodes. Carolyn Harris, Kenny Madrid, and Niko Fernandez oversee the project for Paramount Television Studios.

Reacher: Season 4 - Official Trailer (Alan Ritchson, Sydelle Noel, Chris Marquette) | Comic Con 2026
Check out the trailer for Season 4 of Reacher. Reacher: Season 4 stars Alan Ritchson as Jack Reacher. The new season also stars Sydelle Noel, Chris Marquette, AGNEZ MO, Anggun, Kevin Weisman, Marc Blucas, Kevin Corrigan, and Kathleen Robertson. Reacher: Season 4 will return on Wednesday, August 12, 2026 with the first three episodes and a new episode weekly through September 16 on Prime Video.

Based on the 13th book in Lee Child’s global best-selling series, "Gone Tomorrow," in the fourth season of the action-packed series, when a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, Jack Reacher (Alan Ritchson) is drawn into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power. 

Reacher is produced by Paramount Television Studios and Amazon MGM Studios. The series is written for television by Emmy-nominated writer Nick Santora (FUBAR, Prison Break), who also executive produces and serves as showrunner. In addition to Santora and Child, Ritchson also serves as an executive producer, alongside Don Granger, Scott Sullivan, Mick Betancourt, Lisa Kussner, Sam Hill, Amy Pocha & Seth Cohen. Carolyn Harris and Kenny Madrid are the executives-in-charge of the series for Paramount Television Studios.

Kill the Shadow - Official Release Date Trailer
Check out the latest Kill the Shadow trailer for this upcoming detective RPG to see gameplay and get a peek at the story. Kill the Shadow will be available on PC via Steam on August 5, 2026.

Set within the divided streets of Dark Tide City, you step into the role of Lucas, a former detective haunted by both his past and the mysterious Shadow attached to his back, a supernatural entity capable of reconstructing the final moments of the dead. Rather than changing the past, Lucas uses the Shadow to observe and reconstruct crime scenes exactly as they occurred, piecing together evidence, exposing lies, and uncovering the sinister forces manipulating the city from the shadows.

text:
The Highs and Lows of Marvel Fighting Games (1994 - 2026)
Marvel and video games: a long-storied and sometimes turbulent relationship! Spanning a variety of genres, Marvel games have taken us from the open worlds of Insomniac’s Spider-Man to the character-driven tales of Eidos Montreal's Guardians of the Galaxy, and true icons such as Marvel: Ultimate Alliance, and more, but one genre that's always seen undeniable success has been fighting games.

We've assembled an almost three-decade-long collection of twists, turns, smash hits, and fumbles, from Marvel Vs Capcom to Marvel Tokon Fighting Souls, and other oddities in between.
